signature_moves: Mac-notch-as-face: one black glyph reads simultaneously as the physical notch and a peeking creature with cartoon eyes — the whole product thesis in a single monochrome mark.
System typeface (SF Pro Display) used straight as the wordmark — deliberate native-affiliation move, inherits the platform's crafted first-impression prior.
defects: No UI defects scorable — no app-UI surface supplied.
Icon squint-test risk (estimated) — the small peeking eyes + soft rim may collapse into a solid black blob at 16px Dock/menu-bar size; silhouette survives, the 'face' reading may not.
Marketing backdrop is the default-model abstract soft-mesh look — monochrome saves it from full template-generic; brand-asset note, not an app finding.

aesthetic.direction: Restrained monochrome (grayscale-drenched marketing ground) with the entire boldness budget spent on a single playful mascot glyph — a 'Playful/toy' signature held inside near-Swiss monochrome discipline; system-typeface logotype signals native-Mac affiliation.
peers: Ice / Dropover / Rectangle (icon-style peers — monochrome-mark Mac menu-bar utilities)

psychology: Von Restorff / distinctiveness — a single monochrome mascot mark is engineered for menu-bar/Dock recall; being the 'one different thing' at small size is the whole recognition strategy.
Aesthetic-usability + Jakob's Law — SF Pro Display as logotype borrows the platform's familiar, native-crafted first-impression prior (~50ms appeal judgment) with zero custom type investment.

Jakob's Law / schema (inferred from tagline, NOT image) — the product dwells in the notch, a habitual glance location, so status is where the eye already goes; product-concept inference, no UI evidence.
